evidencePolicy: Real keyboard walking from native Senate spawn through source-confirmed accepted public paths, exact qualified new footway/crossing circuit, and return. No fixture teleport. This is a runnable plan, not a completed journey. Revised local obstacle bypass uses native HCOL, preserves source-node endpoints, and is not an OSM-authored alternative footway. Captured vehicle poses are a snapshot; real-keyboard travel remains required. Parked obstacle authority includes all source parking/curb slots passing actual runtime road checks with stable per-slot vehicle selection, authored initial civilian vehicles, and original/intermediate/final observed unoccupied civilian snapshots with 0.35 m extra clearance; driven police history is excluded. Collinear generated intermediary points are removed only after full new segment checks. All waypoint arrival radii are now 0.06 m. Full-route static capsule sweeps and native controller steps include scenery trunks, props and ground walls. Senate plaza replacement legs are qualified against exact municipal public paving; other local authored bends stay within 2 m of original public-source waypoints and reconnect in the same source order. Real-keyboard travel remains required. When a live pedestrian blocks progress for two seconds, the verifier may author a bounded public-paving detour after fresh source, 0.44 m capsule, parked/current vehicle, supported-area and continuous native Character checks. Only a wholly occupied 0.06 m arrival disk may be replaced, recorded with its observed occupant; protected captures remain exact. Every chosen bend is reached by real camera and keyboard controls. Twelve attempts maximum, 2 m lateral bound and 8 m local extent; failure to qualify does not alter the world or widen arrival/collision tolerances.
